summary: Family steel fabricator (110 staff, EUR 11.3 M); we are 3.4 % of its turnover, sole source of base frame HN 100 on our tooling. Solid supplier: green scorecard (OTD 88 %, 949 ppm), credit index flat 251. It has settled at or below its own ask every year (asked -3.9 %, gave -6.6 %). Few documents. Open deep; use index, forecast and OTD below the 95 % target.
notes: Only signal is the generic 10-day payment e-mail (no distress). No should-cost and no second source, so no rival quote; our leverage is growing spend (+5.6 %) and its habit of settling below ask. We pay 4.4 days late on average (43 % over 5 days), no complaint.

evidence.quote: Could you pay our invoices within 10 days? In return we would grant a cash discount.
43.1 % of invoices paid over 5 days late

arguments: material/energy index, only if it actually fell
notice-period breach: any 2027 increase missed the 90-day deadline
avoid: citing a cost driver that rose
inventing a rival quote: there is no second source
tactics: Open deep: it historically settles below its own ask.
Use the index first, then forecast, then OTD below the 95 % target, one kind per round.
Offer 10-day payment only together with a cash discount or extra price step.
Move in small visible steps; stop when it signals a final offer.
playbook.expected_concession: No arena data; history: settled 0 % on a +3.1 % ask and -1.9 % on a -0.7 % ask, so it gives a bit more than it offers.
